mapper.sql: ID, PW, EMAIL, ADDRESS, TEL, USER_NAME, USER_TYPE, USER_STATUS, BUSINESS_NUMBER, CREATED_TIME, TOTAL_BALANCE, BID_DEPOSIT, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_ID
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE EMAIL = #{email}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS (ID, PW, EMAIL, ADDRESS, TEL, USER_NAME, USER_TYPE, USER_STATUS, CREATED_TIME, TOTAL_BALANCE, BID_DEPOSIT, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_ID) VALUES (#{id}, #{pw}, #{email}, #{address}, #{tel}, #{userName}, #{userType}, COALESCE(#{userStatus}, 'ACTIVE'), SYSTIMESTAMP, COALESCE(#{totalBalance}, 0), COALESCE(#{bidDeposit}, 0), #{provider}, #{providerId})

INSERT INTO USERS (ID, PW, EMAIL, USER_NAME, ADDRESS, TEL, USER_TYPE, USER_STATUS, CREATED_TIME, TOTAL_BALANCE, BID_DEPOSIT, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_ID) VALUES (#{id}, #{pw}, #{email}, #{name}, #{address}, #{tel}, 'BUYER', 'ACTIVE', SYSTIMESTAMP, 0, 0, NULL, NULL)

INSERT INTO USERS (ID, PW, EMAIL, ADDRESS, TEL, USER_NAME, USER_TYPE, USER_STATUS, BUSINESS_NUMBER, CREATED_TIME, TOTAL_BALANCE, BID_DEPOSIT, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_ID) VALUES (#{id}, #{pw}, #{email}, #{address}, #{tel}, #{userName}, 'SELLER', 'PENDING', #{brn}, SYSTIMESTAMP, 0, 0, NULL, NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET USER_TYPE = #{role}, USER_STATUS = CASE WHEN #{role} = 'SELLER' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END WHERE ID = #{id}
